interpretation: Early contraction reduces 134 to 128 registers with zero local allocation/traffic and raises achieved occupancy from 16.65% to 29.10% at block size 256
131072-pair CUDA-event time remains about 0.82 ms; fp64 pipeline activity remains about 79%; do not claim a substantial speedup from occupancy alone
Caps add local allocation and measured LD/ST traffic, even where Nsight derived__local_spilling_requests reports zero; raw counters and runtime kernel properties are retained
No cap was promoted; original validated baseline remains unchanged
Adding all 28 fp64 accumulators naively would require at least 56 32-bit registers for the outputs alone; prefer consumer-specific contractions and bounded output scheduling

solver_mapping.current_geometry: Existing 2D edge/box/disk/conditioned triangle provider, separate from FluxBridge 3D tet prototype
solver_mapping.WCSPH: Analytic wall terms consume lam, G, Cov and hydrostatic contraction, with additional lap/cover/tens channels depending on the scheme
solver_mapping.DFSPH: Shared projection geometry requests the lean provider: lam, G, Cov; fixed geometry is assembled once and reused by projection iterations
solver_mapping.applicability: Same solid-domain kernel moment types; no intrinsic porosity requirement. New 3D provider/kernel-family/derivative validation required before solver benefit.
solver_mapping.boundary_limit_failure_scope: The previously reported 38/90 failures concern native 3D FluxBridge compact evaluation, not evidence against the existing 2D solver boundary path

next_step: Keep the direct-contraction variant available, then design full output scheduling around shared primitives and actual consumer contractions; separately benchmark vertex reload/packed geometry or cooperative output ownership if register liveness grows
limitations: Serialized GPU runs; clocks/caches/desktop activity uncontrolled
Small register reductions do not establish throughput improvement on fp64-compute-limited hardware
No all-28-output register count or speed has yet been measured
No 2D backend or warpSPH solver performance measurement was performed in this experiment
